title: Inventory Clamp All
prompt: A inventory chart must keep every count inside a visible range. Write a function that returns a new array where values below min become min and values above max become max.

explanation.beginner:
Example: inventoryClampAll([-5,10,35], 0, 30) produces [0,10,30]. Apply both bounds so values inside the interval remain unchanged and outliers move to the nearest permitted bound.

Compare “keeps values inside the range”: input [[0,10],0,30] produces [0,10]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
